frequency_question: What proportion of major proposed federal fee regulations successfully reach final rule publication within a comparable timeframe?
membership_rule: Includes all proposed rules designated as economically significant involving fee schedules published in the Federal Register by major regulatory agencies; excludes minor procedural updates and non-fee rules.
window: 279 days from proposal to final rule publication

cases.name: Department of State Visa Fee Adjustments (2012)

coverage_note: 8 named representative major fee rulemaking instances; believed roughly 12 in total comparable instances across recent administrations.
known_gaps: Does not fully account for unprecedented scale of specific proposed fee magnitudes without looking at particulars.
validity_reason: Tied to standard federal rulemaking administrative procedures which remain stable across typical presidential terms.
